item.title: Version 0.8.6
item.description:
Improvements

  • Pro: static scenes stop drawing frames while nothing changes, which saves power
  • Pro: scenes that span several displays present each frame once
  • The Edit Desk window releases its memory when you close it and stays smoother during gestures
  • Library shuffle opens a Workshop scene only when its turn comes

Bug Fixes

  • Deleting the scene a display is showing moves on to the display's playlist, or clears the display if there is nothing else to play — also while wallpapers are turned off or the screen is locked
  • Pro: scenes stored on an external drive reload when the drive mounts
  • Pro: a static scene redraws when a texture finishes loading, instead of keeping the placeholder
  • Pro: more scene scripts run correctly — timers, frametime, getParent, getTransformMatrix, and click and media handlers after a script error
  • Preset, volume and color-space changes apply right away
  • Web wallpapers recover after their content process crashes
  • Pro: Workshop downloads say when Steam has no connection

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
